regime_context: China A-shares are in an extreme one-narrative state: Coal sits alone at the top with score 0.992, cash at 50%, breadth 0.5, and only 2 of 22 themes eligible — a narrow, non-directional leadership structure. Critically, gate_helps is false: on this market's history the absolute-trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown (mean-revert), and the track record shows dir_accuracy of only 0.337, so any lean here is low-conviction by default.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Coal's leadership formally hands off to Banks or Gold: the condition that retires this watch is a confirmed handoff where Banks (crowded, breadth 1.0, durability 0.83) starts outranking Coal on the score with Coal's breadth dropping below 0.4 and Coal flipping to ineligible — or Gold becoming eligible while Coal's durability_bar falls under 0.35. Until one of those observables prints, the one-narrative Coal structure stands.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only theme that is simultaneously rank #1 (score 0.992), eligible, un-crowded (z 0.59, crowded=false), and the sole surviving trend candidate in a one-narrative tape. The trend-gate leg nominally supports holding it — but because gate_helps is false on this market, the edge is drawdown-control intent, not return. The mean-revert hurst tag and 0.5 breadth argue this is a fragile, attention-driven leader rather than a broad trend.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert hurst tag plus cash already at 50% suggests Coal's leadership is a focus artifact of a narrow tape, not durable accumulation; the track record's 0.337 dir_accuracy means even a correctly named leader has no validated forward edge here, and a mean-reverting leader at a score extreme often marks a local top.

falsifier.text: CSI 300 Coal proxy 515220.SS gives up more than 60% of its trailing 10-day gain against the CSI 300 within 20 trading days

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are eligible and ranked #3 with the strongest durability_bar (0.83) and perfect breadth (1.0), but crowding_z is 1.83 and crowded=true — the most crowded theme in this regime. Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution only, never a fade; but for a new lean, a crowded, trend-tagged theme in a mean-revert market offers poor entry asymmetry. Avoid expresses no directional view, just a refusal to chase extension.
theses.dissent: Banks have the highest durability and full breadth — the strongest internal trend health in the whole set — so avoiding them forfeits the one theme with genuine trend texture; crowding can persist in reflexive value/soe rotations

falsifier.text: Banks ETF 512800.SS outperforms Coal 515220.SS by more than 8% cumulative over 20 trading days without a drawdown exceeding its 20-day average

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners are rank #2 (0.935) as the rotational challenger but are ineligible, scorable=false (no ETF proxy), zero breadth (0.0), and durability_bar only 0.31 — a high score with no trend gate approval and no internal confirmation. An underweight lean expresses that this theme's leadership is not yet confirmed by the detector's own eligibility discipline.
theses.dissent: The challenger tag and high score may be the earliest sign of a handoff forming from Coal, and Gold's trend hurst tag could mean the zero breadth is just a lagging confirmation, not absence of a move.

falsifier.text: Gold Miners and related A-share gold/silver names rally more than 10% on expanding breadth (advancers > 40% of the sector) within 20 trading days, without a 5%+ intraday shake-out first

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
